analysis:
Both units are base-side excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 427-1237). The PR touches only documentation: the patch excerpt adds records for cluster served-speed (serving scope and tensorAssistant fields), a `--layer-stride` option on tp-check, and other prose. No code, configuration, authorization, encryption or attestation path changes in the supplied evidence, so I found no security regression.

I checked the visible base text against the threat model. It describes the prefix cache: encrypted SSD checkpoints under the provider cache root, authenticated tenant cache scope, coordinator-authored scope, and image checkpoints having no durable layout. Those statements match T-041 (HMAC lookup tags, 30-minute TTL, account-scoped salt). The changed ranges I can see (head around 4592-4608, 4805-4808, 4866-4891, 6725+) fall outside the supplied excerpts, so I could not evaluate them directly.

The patch excerpt is truncated at the `--layer-stride` hunk. The remaining hunks (6858-6894, 7318-7323, 7444-7454) were not visible. Reviewers of those hunks should check that they do not alter or weaken cache-scope, TTL or tenant-isolation claims in T-041, and that any new served-speed record fields (`serving`, `tensorAssistant`) carry no prompt-derived data or identifiers into shared cluster records.

The documentation describes data placement and does not state a change to cache or isolation behavior. Remaining uncertainty is only the unseen hunks.
